Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
 select document_type, letter_id, letter_title 
 into :donor_letters.s_document_type, 
 :donor_letters.s_letter_id, 
 :donor_letters.s_letter_title 
 from valid_letters 
 where letter_code = :donor_letters.letter_code
 and :donor_letters.generate_date between eff_date and nvl( term_date, sysdate + 1 )
 and version_no = (select max( a.version_no )
 from valid_letters a 
 where a.letter_code = valid_letters.letter_code
 and :donor_letters.generate_date between 
 a.eff_date and nvl( a.term_date, sysdate + 1 ) );
EXCEPTION 
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 when too_many_rows then
 null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
END;

:donor_letters.s_last_reprinted_on := Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, :donor_letters.last_reprinted_on);

PROCEDURE initialise_windows IS

ProgramUnit.Name: CALL_WINDOW_PROGRAM
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE call_window_program (p_window_name varchar2) IS
 pl_id ParamList; 
 pl_name VARCHAR2(10) := 'dondata'; 
BEGIN 

 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF not Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 destroy_parameter_list(pl_id);
 end if;
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 Message('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF;

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_donor_id', TEXT_PARAMETER, '#' || :parameter.p_donor_id || '##');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_chapter_id', TEXT_PARAMETER, :global.chapter_id); 
 call_form( lower(p_window_name) ,NO_HIDE ,NO_REPLACE ,NO_QUERY_ONLY ,pl_id);
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: SHOW_COM_LETTER
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE SHOW_COM_LETTER IS
BEGIN
 clear_message;
 if :donor_letters.donor_id is not null
 and :donor_letters.letter_seq_no is not null then
 go_block( 'donor_letter_text' );
 clear_block( NO_VALIDATE );
 execute_query;
 go_block( 'donor_letters' );
 end if;
END;
